mechanism: Selegiline at higher doses (>10 mg/day) loses MAOi selectivity and may potentiate sympathomimetic effects; testosterone can increase cardiovascular stress and aggression, compounding hypertensive and behavioral risks.
action: Monitor blood pressure and mood/behavioral changes closely; use selegiline at ≤10 mg/day (selective for MAO-B); consider alternative antiparkinsonian agents if behavioral concerns emerge.
